name: @repo/pixel-flow-field
description: A PixelFlowField background component for SmoothUI.

useCases: Dotted grid backdrop that ripples and reacts to the cursor
Developer-tool hero with a technical, plotter-like texture
Section divider with a subtle animated pixel field
compositionHints: Wrap hero copy or a feature grid so it renders above the field
Use a small cellSize with the circle shape for a dotted-paper look
